name: The Pre-PM Show with Terry Spinner
source:
Your best bud, your college roomie, your ride-or-die is sick! Unfortunately, that doesn't mean life stops, and they don't have anybody else to rely on to fill in for them at work. 

So, you'll do.

[From [url=https://pepperparker.itch.io/the-pre-pm-show-with-terry-spinner]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你最好的朋友，你的大学室友，你的“乘车或死亡”病了！不幸的是，这并不意味着生活就此停止，他们的工作也没有其他人可以依靠。

所以，你会做的。

[来自[url=https://pepperparker.itch.io/the-pre-pm-show-with-terry-spinner]itch.io[/url]]
